lines.text: [color=#666666][i]A glowing CRT monitor illuminates a messy bedroom. Empty energy drink cans everywhere.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Knight to E5. Checkmate. Too easy..."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Another grandmaster down. Time for a nap."
[color=#666666][i]The door violently kicks open. Mentor steps in.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Wake up, kid! The screen is rotting your brain!"

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Whoa! How did you get in my room?!"

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "You've got a 2200 ELO but the arms of a wet noodle."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "I'm entering you in the Underground Chessboxing League."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Chess... boxing? No thanks, I bruise easily."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Prize pool is $50,000."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "...Where are my gloves?"
[color=#666666][i]The Rookie nervously adjusts his boxing gloves. Mentor gives a pep talk.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Alright kid. This is it. Keep your guard up and your king safe."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "My stomach is doing flips..."
[color=#666666][i]Suddenly, two guys in hoodies walk into the room smiling brightly.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: dev1
lines.text: [color=#8DE56E][b]DEV 1[/b][/color]   "YO! Huge fan! Thanks so much for playing our indie game!"

lines.speaker: dev2
lines.text: [color=#6ED1B6][b]DEV 2[/b][/color]   "He means it. We've been awake for, uh... I don't actually know."

lines.speaker: dev1
lines.text: [color=#8DE56E][b]DEV 1[/b][/color]   "The chessboxing mechanic? Dude. Pure genius. Our idea."

lines.speaker: dev2
lines.text: [color=#6ED1B6][b]DEV 2[/b][/color]   "...It was my idea."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Uh. Who are these guys?"

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Hey! You're in the wrong room, pals! Get outta here!"

lines.speaker: dev1
lines.text: [color=#8DE56E][b]DEV 1[/b][/color]   "Oops — sorry! Don't forget to leave us a review! Five stars please!"

lines.speaker: dev2
lines.text: [color=#6ED1B6][b]DEV 2[/b][/color]   "Or three. Three is fine. We read them all."
[color=#666666][i]The Devs scurry out of the room.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "...Weirdos. Anyway."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Go out there and do everything you can, son."

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: [color=#CCCCCC][b][ SYSTEM: ELO POINTS INCREASED +45 ][/b][/color]

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Pant... pant... I think I swallowed my mouthguard."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Ha! You caught him in a fork and a right hook!"

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Look at the board. Your ELO is rising."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Yeah... Not bad. Maybe I won't die today."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Don't get cocky. The real fighters are up next."
[color=#666666][i]Camera flashes go off. Magnus blocks the doorway, towering over The Rookie.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: magnus
lines.text: [color=#DC6E6E][b]MAGNUS[/b][/color]   "So. You're the kid from the internet."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "...Hi."

lines.speaker: magnus
lines.text: [color=#DC6E6E][b]MAGNUS[/b][/color]   "Online games are cute. But in the ring, you actually bleed."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Save the tough guy act for the finals, Magnus."

lines.speaker: magnus
lines.text: [color=#DC6E6E][b]MAGNUS[/b][/color]   "Just don't get knocked out before you reach me."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Coach... I think I'm gonna throw up."
[color=#666666][i]The crowd is roaring outside. The championship match is about to begin.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Listen to that crowd. They want blood."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Magnus is flawless on the board. And he hits like a truck."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "He's a machine, yes. But machines run on logic."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "You are unpredictable. You play like a cornered animal."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Thanks. I think."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "Survive the boxing. Confuse him in the chess. Let's go!"

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: [color=#CCCCCC][b][ SYSTEM: ELO RATING — GRANDMASTER ][/b][/color]
[color=#666666][i]Confetti rains down. Magnus is staring at the chessboard in pure shock.[/i][/color]

lines.speaker: magnus
lines.text: [color=#DC6E6E][b]MAGNUS[/b][/color]   "Impossible... a discovered attack? While concussed?"

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "I told you... there's no undo button, Magnus."

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "You did it! You're the champion!"

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Does this mean I get the fifty grand now?"

lines.speaker: mentor
lines.text: [color=#6EAEE5][b]MENTOR[/b][/color]   "It sure does, kid. You earned it."

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: [color=#E5C04C][b]THE ROOKIE[/b][/color]   "Great. I'm going to buy a new graphics card. And sleep for a week."
